mapper.select: SELECT FROM med_patient p WHERE p.id=#{patientId} AND p.owner_user_id=#{userId}

SELECT FROM med_appointment anchor JOIN med_patient p ON p.id=anchor.patient_id JOIN med_slot sl ON sl.id=anchor.slot_id JOIN med_schedule s ON s.id=sl.schedule_id JOIN med_doctor d ON d.id=s.doctor_id LEFT JOIN med_encounter attended ON attended.appointment_id=anchor.id WHERE anchor.id=#{anchorAppointmentId} AND d.user_id=#{userId} AND d.status='ENABLED' AND (anchor.status='BOOKED' OR attended.id IS NOT NULL)
AND (attended.id IS NULL OR attended.doctor_id=d.id)
mapper.sql: a.id AS appointment_id,sl.work_date,sl.start_time,sl.end_time,d.id AS doctor_id, COALESCE(a.booking_doctor_name,d.name) AS doctor_name, COALESCE(a.booking_department_name,dep.name) AS department_name, COALESCE(a.booking_clinic_room_name,room.name) AS clinic_room_name,a.status AS appointment_status, e.id AS encounter_id,e.status AS encounter_status,mr.chief_complaint,mr.diagnosis, rx.id AS prescription_id,b.status AS bill_status,rx.total_amount, COALESCE(a.booking_patient_name,p.name) AS patient_name, CASE WHEN a.booking_snapshot_at IS NOT NULL THEN a.booking_doctor_title ELSE d.title END AS doctor_title, CASE WHEN source_a.id IS NOT NULL THEN source_e.id ELSE NULL END AS source_encounter_id, source_a.id AS source_appointment_id,source_sl.work_date AS source_work_date, (a.booking_snapshot_at IS NOT NULL) AS has_booking_snapshot

med_appointment a JOIN med_patient p ON p.id=a.patient_id JOIN med_slot sl ON sl.id=a.slot_id JOIN med_schedule s ON s.id=sl.schedule_id JOIN med_doctor d ON d.id=s.doctor_id JOIN med_department dep ON dep.id=d.department_id JOIN med_clinic_room room ON room.id=s.clinic_room_id LEFT JOIN med_encounter e ON e.appointment_id=a.id LEFT JOIN med_medical_record mr ON mr.encounter_id=e.id AND e.status='COMPLETED' LEFT JOIN med_prescription rx ON rx.encounter_id=e.id AND rx.status='ISSUED' LEFT JOIN med_bill b ON b.prescription_id=rx.id LEFT JOIN med_encounter source_e ON source_e.id=a.source_encounter_id AND source_e.status='COMPLETED' LEFT JOIN med_appointment source_a ON source_a.id=source_e.appointment_id AND source_a.patient_id=a.patient_id LEFT JOIN med_slot source_sl ON source_sl.id=source_a.slot_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM med_appointment WHERE patient_id=#{patientId}
SELECT FROM WHERE a.id=#{appointmentId} AND a.patient_id=#{patientId}

SELECT mr.id,mr.encounter_id,mr.chief_complaint,mr.present_illness,mr.diagnosis,mr.advice,mr.version,mr.updated_at FROM med_medical_record mr JOIN med_encounter e ON e.id=mr.encounter_id WHERE mr.encounter_id=#{encounterId} AND e.status='COMPLETED'
SELECT id,from_status,to_status,event_type,actor_user_id,created_at FROM med_appointment_status_log WHERE appointment_id=#{appointmentId} ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT id,from_status,to_status,event_type,actor_user_id,created_at FROM med_encounter_status_log WHERE encounter_id=#{encounterId} ORDER BY created_at,id
